svg.aria-label: Go-Explore. Why it works: with five doors passed 1 time in 10, random play without saves needs about 100,000 attempts; saving after each door needs about 50. One round: pick a place from the archive, return to it by loading its saved state, explore at random until death, save the new places, and repeat until the goal.
svg.text: WHY IT WORKS · ADD, DON’T MULTIPLY
Five doors. Random play gets through each one 1 time in 10, and a failed attempt dies.
ONE ROUND · REPEATED UNTIL THE GOAL
The archive holds every place reached so far, each with a saved state that returns there. Blue: in the archive. Red: this round.
Draw a place from the archive.
or the time limit. New places
